key_insight: The paper builds a machine-checked Lean 4 framework that certifies core quantum neural network (QNN) theory by formally proving expressivity and trainability results under explicit hypotheses.
engineering_relevance: This provides a verifiable foundation for designing QNN architectures with guaranteed expressivity, controlled parameterization, and analytically grounded trainability properties.
method: Formalized QNN theory in Lean 4 with proof-kernel verification
Proved exact single-qubit QNN characterizations, a quantum phase processing theorem, and a quantum Fisher-information rank ceiling
Derived loss-variance and loss-reconstruction results using dynamical-Lie-algebra coordinates and named hypotheses
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a connected Lean 4 development with eight corrections and clarifications identified from the informal arguments, indicating formal verification added rigor.
watch_item: Several results depend on explicit assumptions or named hypotheses, so practical QNN design still requires checking that real hardware or model families satisfy those conditions.
paper_title: An Agentic Formalization for Certified Quantum Neural Network Design
